tours.label: Skills, elements and pillars
tours.message: 24 instructional design skills, the 38 elements they recommend or check, and the pillars they uphold.

scenes.caption: 7 families of instructional design skills in PRAW.
Universal design, accessibility and cognitive load.
The elements skills reach for most: self-check, stop-note, editable-table, multiple-choice, video-player, a11y-collapse, fill-in-the-blanks, flash-card.
Each skill upholds pillars (proposed for review in haxtheweb/issues#3257).
Gaps: elements no skill covers yet, and a skill with no element to act on.
